messages:
sasha (infra-eng): Heads up — planning a small Dedicated pool expansion for EU next week. Need to confirm vendor A100 availability and whether we can get short-term burst capacity (10 GPUs) for a 48h soak. Anyone seen firm ETA from vendors? @kevin FYI can we queue procurement?

kevin (procurement): looping in Lina but quick update: current GCP quota in eu-west1 is tight, we can request limit increase but lead time is ~5 business days. For vendor partners (bare-metal) Lina might have a faster lane. filing a PO pre-approval now.

lina (vendor-liaison): talked to two partners — VendorX can commit 8xA100 in eu-west within 72h if we sign an accelerated addendum. VendorY has 12xA100 but needs 7-day lead time for rack prep. Pricing for VendorX burst is ~1.8x list rate. sending contract snippet to kevin.

infra-bot: [alert] capacity-forecast: projected shortfall in eu-west for Dedicated pools on 2026-03-25 if expansion proceeds without burst. See /capacity dashboard.

maria (capacity): We're projecting peak qps for the new workload ~6500 rps, baseline pool needs 16 A100s sustained. For a 48h soak we only need 10 extra to validate autoscaling + cache hit rate. Two options: 1) VendorX 8 GPUs + ephemeral spot blend of 2 from cloud, or 2) wait 7 days for VendorY full 12 GPUs and run longer soak.

jon (platform): quick question — can we spin up a temporary reserved instance on GCP with a short reservation (48h)? I thought we could do short-term reservation via API:

```bash
gcloud compute reservations create redwood-eu-temp --zone=europe-west1-b --specific-reservation-instance-amount=2 --machine-type=a2-highgpu-1g --reservation-length=PT48H
```

kevin (procurement): GCP reservations are possible but quota still blocks creation if we don't have spare quota. We can try the reservation call as a request to support to fast-track, but not reliable under short notice. Lina — can VendorX provide a written ETA for the 8 units? We need SLA language for the 48h commitment.

lina (vendor-liaison): yes, I'll ask for a signed PO-confirmation email. VendorX legal ok with 48h commitment if we accept the addendum. ETA: contract + provisioning within 72h from sign.

maria (capacity): If we accept VendorX burst, adjust autoscaler min to account for 8 extra GPUs and enable spot blend for the remaining 2. Also add a cache-prefill job to avoid token storm on first day. Recommend feature-flagging the soak to limit production traffic to 20% initially.

sasha (infra-eng): sounds good. Can we get a firm cost estimate (delta vs. normal) and a checklist for rollback if the vendor nodes flake? I'll sign off on the addendum once kevin posts the numbers.

kevin (procurement): estimated delta ~+70% for the 48h burst (VendorX premium), +GCP support fast-track fee if we request quota expedite. I'll post a short PO summary in the #finance thread.

jon (platform): for rollback checklist: 1) disable pool routing, 2) failover to eu-central region, 3) scale down newly added nodes via orchestration, 4) invalidate local cache keys older than 12h. I'll draft the runbook and paste here.

sasha (infra-eng): perfect. Lina — please get that PO-confirmation email and vendor contact. Kevin — once you have final numbers I'll approve. Maria — start config changes in a branch and tag me for review.

maria (capacity): will do. Creating PR w/ autoscaler + prefill job. tag: #1876543210-burst-soak. ETA for PR: 3h.

lina (vendor-liaison): vendor contact and conditional confirmation email sent to kevin. attaching provisioning SLA.

kevin (procurement): PO summary posted. Total expected incremental spend ~€8.6k for 48h burst incl. premium and support. Approve and sign? :thumbsup: or :thumbsdown:?

sasha (infra-eng): :thumbsup: from me. please proceed.

jon (platform): :thumbsup: — i'll be on-call during the soak window.

maria (capacity): PR opened and linked. monitoring dashboard widgets updated.

infra-bot: [notice] scheduled maintenance window reserved for vendor burst on 2026-03-25T09:00:00Z — stakeholder notifications sent.

sasha (infra-eng): great work team. We'll circle back in the weekly infra sync with post-soak metrics. Thanks everyone.
